title: GateDecisionRecord
description: One entry of LoopState.gate_decisions (autopilot) or Checkpoint.gate_decisions (autopilot-roadmap). Superset of ApprovalDecision.to_audit_record().

default_action.description: The posture's default_action as APPLIED, not necessarily as declared: `_apply_default` overwrites this to `block` when a `proceed` default fires on an undelivered notification (`notified: false`). It is not safe to infer the posture's *declared* default_action from this field alone -- combine it with `notified` (present when an approval was filed) to distinguish a genuine `default_action: block` timeout (`notified: true`) from an undelivered `proceed` forced closed (`notified: false`).

decision_id.description: Stable id assigned by the supervise gate router; approval_ref = 'gate-decision:<decision_id>'.

verb.description: Which supervise verb raised the gate. Optional, and only meaningful when source is 'supervise'.

notified.description: Whether the coordinator's push_notification call reported delivery when this decision's approval was filed, threaded from ApprovalDecision.notified (added to the existing ri-05 dataclass by this change) through to_audit_record(). Present only on notify_with_timeout records that filed an approval; null for a console-originated roadmap_approval answer, where no coordinator delivery concept applies. Combined with default_action it lets a reader distinguish a genuine default_action:block timeout (notified=true) from an undelivered proceed forced to block (notified=false).

roadmap_fingerprint.description: sha256 over the roadmap's authorized DAG shape (item_id, change_id, depends_on, external_depends_on, normalized_status) at evaluation time. Stamped on every roadmap_approval record; require_approval_ref rejects a reference whose stored fingerprint does not match the roadmap's current shape.

timeout_seconds.description: The posture's notify_with_timeout window in effect when this decision was made, when approval_id is set; used to compute a pending-gate deadline for a filed approval (requested_at + timeout_seconds).
